statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (a : ℝ), 0 < a → YuiMeasure a A = MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a A ∧ (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0) ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ⊤) ∧ (YuiMeasure a A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a) ∧ (YuiMeasure a A = ⊤ → ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ dimH A)
proof:
intro k A a ha
let d : ℝ≥0 := ⟨a, ha.le⟩
have hd : (d : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal a := by
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal (p := d)).symm
have hn := h_T001 (YuiEucl k) A a ha
have hz : dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal a → YuiMeasure a A = 0 := by
  intro h
  rw [hn]
  exact hausdorffMeasure_of_dimH_lt (d := d) (by simpa only [hd] using h)
have ht : ENNReal.ofReal a < dimH A → YuiMeasure a A = ⊤ := by
  intro h
  rw [hn]
  exact hausdorffMeasure_of_lt_dimH (d := d) (by simpa only [hd] using h)
refine ⟨hn, hz, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro h
  apply le_of_not_gt
  intro hlt
  have hc := ht hlt
  rw [h] at hc
  exact ENNReal.zero_ne_top hc
· intro h
  apply le_of_not_gt
  intro hlt
  have hc := hz hlt
  rw [h] at hc
  exact ENNReal.top_ne_zero hc
